name: Red Sea
overview: The Red Sea holds a pivotal place in Israel's history as the site where God demonstrated His power and deliverance. Scripture recounts how a mighty west wind cast the devastating locusts into the Red Sea, removing this plague from Egypt (Exodus 10:19). Most notably, God led the Israelites through the wilderness of the Red Sea, guiding them safely out of Egypt (Exodus 13:18), and then miraculously parted its waters so they could cross on dry ground. In judgment against Pharaoh and his army, the waters closed upon them, drowning the pursuing forces and securing Israel's salvation (Exodus 14:9; 15:1,4). These events underscore God's sovereign protection and triumph on behalf of His people.
